independent_clearance.AIS_attempt_timing_scope: Every complete AISBufferPlanner.choose and entire AIS selection-through-native-assessment attempt, including the final unapplied stop or exception. Both streams are matched to all applied replay timers; the applied-decision scope also includes controller/actuator selection and any fallback.
independent_clearance.launch_tube_check_scope: Observed native first300s displacement relative to launch origin satisfies the assumed30m+2m/s*t disk; this empirical check is not a general speed-bound proof.
independent_clearance.regatta_timing_scope: Reported last upstream forecast-search cost, possibly repeated by cached references. It is separate from AIS selection and is not an end-to-end control-decision or unique-call count.
independent_clearance.physical_clearance_scope: All4physical contacts throughout. Before acquisition the fourth receives a labeled hypothetical65s allowance; report-centered clearance uses only actually received contacts.
independent_clearance.measurement: Exact minima on relative-position and radius chords between 0.05 s plant integration samples; report- and truth-centered uncertainty are distinct.
